book.name: Isikiyel
book.title: Isikiyel Isikiyel Bin Gibit Wed Brom God Deya Langa Bebalon

content: Det pawa blanga YAWEI bin libum det Serramoni Pleis

Wal aibin luk deya ontop langa det fletwan ruf, en ontop langa detlot einjul gulum tjerabim samting bin deya. Imbin luk jis laik det king speshalwan tjeya, brabli shainiwan, garram purdiwan bluwan ston.

Wal God bin tok langa det men hubin werrimon detlot gudwan klos. Imbin tok, “Yu go rait langa midul langa detlot wil, deya andanith langa detlot tjerabim en yu garra gajim bigismob hotwan eshis garram yu bingga. Yu garra tjakam en spredimat detlot hotwan eshis oloba langa dijan taun.” Aibin wotjim im go.
Detlot tjerabim bin jandapbat sauthsaid langa det Serramoni Pleis wen det men bin go insaid, en klaud bin gaburrumap det kotyad.

Det brabli shainiwan lait blanga YAWEI bin gowap brom detlot tjerabim en go langa det dowawei langa det Serramoni Pleis. En det klaud bin gaburrumap det Serramoni Pleis, en det kotyad bin jidan garram brabli braitwan lait oloba.
Detlot wing blanga detlot tjerabim bin meigimbat loda nois en det nois bin go oloba langa det kotyad. Imbin brabli noisiwan jis laik YAWEI det brabli haibala boswan God bin toktokbat.

Wen YAWEI bin dalim det men hubin werrimon detlot gudwan klos blanga gajim det faiya brom det midulpat langa detlot wil weya bin jidan andanith langa detlot tjerabim, wal det men bin go en jandap wansaid langa detlot wil na.

Wanbala tjerabim bin pudumat im bingga en gajim detlot hotwan eshis weya bin jidan deya langa olabat, wal imbin gajim detlot hotwan eshis en gibit langa det men hubin werrimon detlot gudwan klos. Wal det men bin gajim detlot hotwan eshis en imbin gowei.
Wal aibin luk holot detlot tjerabim bin abum bingga wulijim men andanith langa olabat wing.

En aibin luk deibin ol abum fobala wil en detlot wil bin ol luk seim, en detlot wil bin jidan wansaid langa detlot fobala enimul. Detlot wil bin jidan brabli shainiwan jis laik det brabli purdiwan ston, en ola wil bin abum najawan wil kroswei insaid langa det feswan wil, wulijim detlot enimul gin mub eniweya olabat wandim go en nomo tenim miselp.
Holot olabat bodi, bekboun, bingga, wing en wil bin abum ai oloba.
Wal aibin irrim sambodi gulum olabat detlot wil weya gorangoranbat.
Ebri tjerabim bin abum fobala feis. Det feswan feis bin laiga buligi, en det sekanwan feis bin laiga men, en det namba 3 feis bin laiga laiyan, en det namba 4 feis bin laiga igul.
Detlot tjerabim bin detlot seimwan tjerabim weya aibin luk deya wansaid langa det Keba Riba. Wal wen detlot tjerabim bin gidap en go langa top,

en deibin ol mub, detlot wil bin ol mub garram olabat du. Wen deibin oldei spredimat olabat wing blanga flaiwei, detlot wil bin go garram olabat du. Detlot tjerabim bin oldei mub garram detlot wil du.

Wen detlot tjerabim bin oldei wandim stap, wal detlot wil bin oldei stap du, en wen detlot tjerabim bin oldei wandim flaiwei, detlot wil du bin oldei mub garram olabat, dumaji detlot tjerabim bin oldei jidan bos blanga detlot wil.
Wal afta det shainiwan lait blanga YAWEI bin gowei brom det dowawei blanga det Serramoni Pleis, en imbin jidan deya ontop langa detlot tjerabim.

Deibin spredimatbat olabat wing en deibin flaiwei, en detlot wil bin go garram olabat du. Deibin stap deya langa det sanrais geit deya langa det Serramoni Pleis, en det shainiwan lait blanga det God blanga ola Isreil pipul bin jidan deya ontop langa detlot tjerabim.
Wen aibin luk olabat aibin sabi deibin detlot seimwan enimul weya aibin luk basdam langa det Keba Riba. Deibin jidan andanith langa det God blanga ola Isreil pipul.

Olabat holot bin abum fobala feis en fobala wing, en deibin abum fobala bingga wulijim men andanith langa olabat wing. Detlot seimwan tjerabim na aibin luk deya langa det Keba Riba basdam en ol detlot tjerabim bin ol mub wanwei. Detlot seimwan tjerabim na aibin luk basdam.
